question: According to the Arkansas CDL Manual, what must happen before an applicant can proceed to the Road Test?
choice_a: The applicant must complete Exercise 4 only
choice_b: The Basic Control Skills test must be passed
choice_c: The applicant must pass a written retest
choice_d: The examiner must waive the skills exercises
explanation: The manual states under "Road Test": "Remember, the Basic Control Skills test must be passed before you can proceed to the Road Test."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-2

question: How many exercises make up the Basic Control Skills test described in Section 12 of the Arkansas CDL Manual?
choice_a: Two
choice_b: Three
choice_c: Four
choice_d: Five
explanation: Section 12 describes four exercises: Exercise 1 - Forward Stop, Exercise 2 - Straight Line Backing, Exercise 3 - Forward Offset Tracking, and Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing.
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-1

question: In Exercise 1 (Forward Stop), what must the applicant do while driving forward through the alley?
choice_a: Stop as many times as needed to align the vehicle
choice_b: Stop with the front most part of the vehicle within the box at the end of the alley without going past it, and stop only once
choice_c: Back up if the vehicle overshoots the box
choice_d: Sound the horn continuously while approaching the box
explanation: The manual states the applicant must stop with the front most part of the vehicle within the box at the end of the alley without going past it, and "You may stop only once."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-1

question: In Exercise 1 (Forward Stop), what three actions must the applicant take once the vehicle has stopped in the box?
choice_a: Turn off the engine, open the door, and check the mirrors
choice_b: Set the parking brake, shift to neutral/park, and sound the horn
choice_c: Apply the four-way flashers, exit the vehicle, and check the tires
choice_d: Release the clutch, shift into first gear, and wave to the examiner
explanation: The manual instructs: "When you have stopped, set your parking brake, shift to neutral/park, and sound the horn."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-1

question: In Exercise 2 (Straight Line Backing), how far must the applicant back the vehicle?
choice_a: Until the rear of the vehicle reaches the first cone
choice_b: Back straight through the alley until the front of the vehicle has cleared the last set of cones at the far end of the alley
choice_c: Back a fixed distance of three feet
choice_d: Back until signaled by the examiner to stop at the halfway point
explanation: The manual states the applicant must "back straight through the alley until the front of your vehicle has cleared the last set of cones at the far end of the alley."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-2

question: What is scored during Exercise 2 (Straight Line Backing), and how many free pull-ups and vehicle exits are allowed?
choice_a: Scored for encroachments only; no pull-ups or exits allowed
choice_b: Scored for pull-ups, encroachments, and final position; one free pull-up and one exit to check around the vehicle allowed
choice_c: Scored for speed only; two free pull-ups allowed
choice_d: Scored for steering smoothness; unlimited exits allowed
explanation: The manual states applicants "will be scored for pull-ups, encroachments, and final position" and are "allowed one (1) free pull-up and may safely exit the vehicle only one (1) time to check around the vehicle."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-2

question: What does Exercise 3 (Forward Offset Tracking) require the applicant to demonstrate?
choice_a: The ability to back a vehicle in a straight line without stopping
choice_b: The ability to maneuver a vehicle around other objects while moving forward without stopping
choice_c: The ability to parallel park at the end of an alley
choice_d: The ability to make a controlled stop within a marked box
explanation: The manual states: "You will demonstrate your ability to maneuver a vehicle around other objects while moving forward without stopping."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-2

question: During Exercise 3 (Forward Offset Tracking), what is an applicant NOT allowed to do?
choice_a: Use turn signals
choice_b: Stop, back-up, or exit the vehicle during the exercise
choice_c: Shift gears while moving
choice_d: Check mirrors while steering
explanation: The manual states: "You are NOT allowed to stop, back-up, or exit the vehicle during this exercise. If you stop, the exercise will be ended."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-2

question: What is scored during Exercise 3 (Forward Offset Tracking)?
choice_a: Encroachments and forward tracking clearance (rear tire between the cone and the line)
choice_b: Pull-ups and final position only
choice_c: Time to complete the exercise
choice_d: Number of gear shifts used
explanation: The manual states: "You will be scored for encroachments and forward tracking clearance (rear tire between the cone and the line)."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-2

question: In Exercise 4 (Reverse Offset Backing), how close must the rear most part of the vehicle come to the rear of the alley?
choice_a: Within one (1) foot
choice_b: Within three (3) feet
choice_c: Within five (5) feet
choice_d: Within ten (10) feet
explanation: The manual requires offset backing into the alley, "bringing the rear most part of your vehicle ... within three (3) feet of the rear of the alley," stopping in the three-foot box at the end of the alley.
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-2

question: How many free pull-ups and vehicle exits are allowed during Exercise 4 (Reverse Offset Backing)?
choice_a: One free pull-up and one exit
choice_b: Two free pull-ups and a maximum of two exits to check around the vehicle
choice_c: Three free pull-ups and unlimited exits
choice_d: No free pull-ups and no exits allowed
explanation: The manual states applicants "are allowed two (2) free pull-ups and may exit the vehicle a maximum of two (2) times to check around the vehicle during this exercise."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-3

question: What must an applicant do if they back beyond the rear boundary of the alley during Exercise 4?
choice_a: Immediately exit the vehicle and end the test
choice_b: Pull straight forward past the alley entrance until signaled by the examiner to stop, prior to resuming the exercise
choice_c: Continue backing until the vehicle stops on its own
choice_d: Request a restart of the entire Basic Control Skills test
explanation: The manual states: "If you back beyond the rear boundary of the alley, you will be required to pull straight forward past the alley entrance until you are signaled by the examiner to stop, prior to resuming the exercise."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-2

topic: Basic Control Skills - Failure to Follow Instructions
question: What can result from failing to follow the examiner's instructions for completing an exercise as directed?
choice_a: A warning only, with no effect on the score
choice_b: An automatic failure, and the test may be terminated by the examiner
choice_c: A requirement to repeat only that exercise
choice_d: A ten-point deduction from the final score
explanation: The manual warns: "Failure to follow examiner instructions for completing the exercise as directed may result in an automatic failure and the test may be terminated by the examiner."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-1

question: According to the manual, what is an example of an "unsafe act" that may result in automatic failure during the Basic Control Skills test?
choice_a: Sounding the horn after completing an exercise
choice_b: Forgetting to set the parking brake or opening the door while in motion
choice_c: Using a turn signal before a maneuver
choice_d: Checking mirrors before backing
explanation: The manual gives examples of unsafe acts: "forgetting to set the parking brake or opening the door while in motion," which may result in automatic failure and test termination.
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 12 - Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test, p. 12-1

question: During the on-road driving test, what three things must the applicant do at all times, according to the Arkansas CDL Manual?
choice_a: Use only automatic transmissions, avoid highways, and stay under 40 mph
choice_b: Wear a safety belt, obey all traffic signs/signals/laws, and complete the test without an accident or moving violation
choice_c: Keep windows down, use hazard lights continuously, and avoid intersections
choice_d: Drive only during daylight, avoid railroad crossings, and stay in the left lane
explanation: The manual states applicants must "Wear your safety belt," "Obey all traffic signs, signals, and laws," and "Complete the test without an accident or moving violation."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-1

question: What happens if the on-road test route does not include a certain traffic situation, such as a railroad crossing?
choice_a: The examiner automatically passes the applicant on that section
choice_b: The applicant may be asked to simulate the situation by telling the examiner what they are or would be doing
choice_c: The test is rescheduled to a route that includes it
choice_d: That portion of the test is simply skipped and not scored
explanation: The manual states: "If your test route does not have certain traffic situations, you may be asked to simulate a traffic situation. You will do this by telling the examiner what you are or would be doing if you were in that traffic situation."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-1

question: According to the manual, what defines "unsafe coasting" during a turn on the on-road driving test?
choice_a: Braking too gently before the turn
choice_b: Having the vehicle out of gear (clutch depressed or gearshift in neutral) for more than the length of the vehicle
choice_c: Using a turn signal too early
choice_d: Failing to check mirrors before turning
explanation: The manual defines unsafe coasting as occurring "when your vehicle is out of gear (clutch depressed or gearshift in neutral) for more than the length of your vehicle."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-1

question: How far from the nearest rail must a commercial driver stop when required to stop at a railroad crossing, according to Section 13 of the Arkansas CDL Manual?
choice_a: Within 25 feet but not less than 10 feet
choice_b: Within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet
choice_c: Within 100 feet but not less than 25 feet
choice_d: Exactly 20 feet
explanation: The manual states drivers required to stop at railroad crossings must "Stop the vehicle within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet from the nearest rail."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-3

question: During the school bus student discharge maneuver, how far away from students must the bus come to a complete stop?
choice_a: At least 5 feet away
choice_b: At least 10 feet away
choice_c: At least 15 feet away
choice_d: At least 20 feet away
explanation: The manual states: "Bring school bus to a complete stop at least 10' away from students at the stop."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-3

topic: On-Road Driving Test - General Driving Behaviors
question: Per the manual's guidance on brake usage (13.1.13(c)) during the on-road test, what should a driver avoid doing?
choice_a: Riding or pumping the brake, or braking harshly; the driver should brake smoothly using steady pressure
choice_b: Using the brake at all in an intersection
choice_c: Downshifting before braking
choice_d: Braking before checking mirrors
explanation: The manual instructs: "Do not ride or pump brake. Do not brake harshly. Brake smoothly using steady pressure."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-4

question: According to Section 13's lane usage guidance, where should a left turn on a multiple lane road be completed?
choice_a: In any open lane on the far side of the intersection
choice_b: In the lane directly to the right of the center line
choice_c: In the right-most (curb) lane
choice_d: In the lane closest to oncoming traffic
explanation: The manual states a driver should "Complete a turn in the proper lane on a multiple lane road (vehicle should finish a left turn in the lane directly to the right of the center line)."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-4

question: What does Section 13's steering guidance (13.1.15) say about hand position while driving the on-road test?
choice_a: One hand may remain on the wheel at all times
choice_b: Both hands should be on the steering wheel at all times unless shifting, then returned to the wheel once the shift is complete
choice_c: Hands should be at the 10 and 2 position only during turns
choice_d: Hand position is not scored during the on-road test
explanation: The manual states: "Keep both hands on the steering wheel at all times unless shifting. Once you have completed shift, return both hands to the steering wheel."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-4

question: In the Stop/Start maneuver (13.1.6), what must the driver do once stopped, before applying the parking brake?
choice_a: Turn off the four-way emergency flashers
choice_b: Cancel the turn signal and activate the four-way emergency flashers
choice_c: Open the driver's door to check surroundings
choice_d: Shift directly into reverse
explanation: The manual's sequence for the stop is: cancel the turn signal, then "Activate your four-way emergency flashers," then "Apply the parking brake."
source_note: AR CDL Manual (AAMVA 2022 Modernized Testing System, Version: March 2025), Section 13 - On-Road Driving, p. 13-2
